bucket.description: The name of the bucket that contains the managed folder.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

force_destroy.description:
Allows the deletion of a managed folder even if contains
objects. If a non-empty managed folder is deleted, any objects
within the folder will remain in a simulated folder with the
same name.
force_destroy.rationale: Force destroy can lead to unintentional data deletion

name.description:
The name of the managed folder expressed as a path. Must include
trailing '/'. For example, 'example_dir/example_dir2/'.
